steps.query:
WITH l0 AS (
  SELECT :b0 AS node_id FROM dual
),
l1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.target_node_id AS node_id
  FROM pk_edges e JOIN l0 p ON e.source_node_id = p.node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b1 AND e.display_relation IN (:b2, :b3, :b4, :b5)
),
ans AS (
  SELECT n.node_id, n.name, n.node_type
  FROM l1 lz JOIN pk_nodes n ON n.node_id = lz.node_id
  WHERE 1=1 AND n.node_type IN (:b6)
  ORDER BY n.node_id FETCH FIRST 41 ROWS ONLY
),
ls0 AS (
  SELECT node_id answer_node_id, node_id current_node, node_id path_nodes, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) path_edges, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) predicates, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) displays FROM ans
),
ls1 AS (
  SELECT p.answer_node_id, MIN(e.source_node_id) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) current_node, MIN(e.source_node_id || CHR(31) || p.path_nodes) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_nodes, MIN(e.edge_id || CASE WHEN p.path_edges IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.path_edges END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_edges, MIN(e.predicate || CASE WHEN p.predicates IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.predicates END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) predicates, MIN(NVL(e.display_relation, '') || CASE WHEN p.displays IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.displays END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) displays
  FROM ls0 p
  JOIN pk_edges e ON e.target_node_id = p.current_node
  JOIN l0 allowed ON allowed.node_id = e.source_node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b7 AND e.display_relation IN (:b8, :b9, :b10, :b11)
  GROUP BY p.answer_node_id
),
support_rows AS (
  SELECT a.node_id answer_node_id, p.path_nodes, p.path_edges, p.predicates, p.displays FROM ans a JOIN ls1 p ON p.answer_node_id = a.node_id
)
SELECT 'node' kind, node_id c1, name c2, node_type c3, NULL c4, NULL c5, NULL c6 FROM ans
UNION ALL
SELECT 'support' kind, answer_node_id c1, path_nodes c2, path_edges c3, predicates c4, displays c5, 'complete expansion path' c6 FROM support_rows

  SELECT :b0 AS node_id FROM dual
),
a1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.target_node_id AS node_id
  FROM pk_edges e JOIN a0 p ON e.source_node_id = p.node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b1
),
b0 AS (
  SELECT :b2 AS node_id FROM dual
),
b1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.target_node_id AS node_id
  FROM pk_edges e JOIN b0 p ON e.source_node_id = p.node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b3
),
ans AS (
  SELECT n.node_id, n.name, n.node_type
  FROM a1 ax JOIN b1 bx ON ax.node_id = bx.node_id
  JOIN pk_nodes n ON n.node_id = ax.node_id
  WHERE 1=1 AND n.node_type IN (:b4)
  ORDER BY n.node_id FETCH FIRST 41 ROWS ONLY
),
as0 AS (
  SELECT node_id answer_node_id, node_id current_node, node_id path_nodes, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) path_edges, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) predicates, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) displays FROM ans
),
as1 AS (
  SELECT p.answer_node_id, MIN(e.source_node_id) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) current_node, MIN(e.source_node_id || CHR(31) || p.path_nodes) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_nodes, MIN(e.edge_id || CASE WHEN p.path_edges IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.path_edges END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_edges, MIN(e.predicate || CASE WHEN p.predicates IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.predicates END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) predicates, MIN(NVL(e.display_relation, '') || CASE WHEN p.displays IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.displays END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) displays
  FROM as0 p
  JOIN pk_edges e ON e.target_node_id = p.current_node
  JOIN a0 allowed ON allowed.node_id = e.source_node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b5
  GROUP BY p.answer_node_id
),
bs0 AS (
  SELECT node_id answer_node_id, node_id current_node, node_id path_nodes, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) path_edges, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) predicates, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) displays FROM ans
),
bs1 AS (
  SELECT p.answer_node_id, MIN(e.source_node_id) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) current_node, MIN(e.source_node_id || CHR(31) || p.path_nodes) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_nodes, MIN(e.edge_id || CASE WHEN p.path_edges IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.path_edges END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_edges, MIN(e.predicate || CASE WHEN p.predicates IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.predicates END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) predicates, MIN(NVL(e.display_relation, '') || CASE WHEN p.displays IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.displays END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) displays
  FROM bs0 p
  JOIN pk_edges e ON e.target_node_id = p.current_node
  JOIN b0 allowed ON allowed.node_id = e.source_node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b6
  GROUP BY p.answer_node_id
),
support_a AS (SELECT a.node_id answer_node_id, p.path_nodes, p.path_edges, p.predicates, p.displays FROM ans a JOIN as1 p ON p.answer_node_id = a.node_id),
support_b AS (SELECT a.node_id answer_node_id, p.path_nodes, p.path_edges, p.predicates, p.displays FROM ans a JOIN bs1 p ON p.answer_node_id = a.node_id)

UNION ALL
SELECT 'support' kind, answer_node_id c1, path_nodes c2, path_edges c3, predicates c4, displays c5, 'intersection leg 1' c6 FROM support_a
UNION ALL
SELECT 'support' kind, answer_node_id c1, path_nodes c2, path_edges c3, predicates c4, displays c5, 'intersection leg 2' c6 FROM support_b

steps.query:
WITH l0 AS (
  SELECT :b0 AS node_id FROM dual
),
l1 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.target_node_id AS node_id
  FROM pk_edges e JOIN l0 p ON e.source_node_id = p.node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b1
),
a1 AS (SELECT node_id anchor, node_id cur FROM l1),
a2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.anchor, e.target_node_id cur FROM pk_edges e JOIN a1 p ON e.source_node_id=p.cur WHERE e.predicate = :b2 AND e.display_relation IN (:b3)),
grp AS (SELECT cur node_id FROM a2 GROUP BY cur HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT anchor) >= :b4),
ans AS (SELECT nd.node_id, nd.name, nd.node_type FROM grp JOIN pk_nodes nd ON nd.node_id=grp.node_id WHERE 1=1 AND nd.node_type IN (:b5)),
cntp0 AS (
  SELECT :b6 node_id, :b7 path_nodes, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) path_edges, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) predicates, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000)) displays FROM dual
),
cntp1 AS (
  SELECT e.target_node_id node_id, MIN(p.path_nodes || CHR(31) || e.target_node_id) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) path_nodes, MIN(CASE WHEN p.path_edges IS NULL THEN e.edge_id ELSE p.path_edges || CHR(31) || e.edge_id END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) path_edges, MIN(CASE WHEN p.predicates IS NULL THEN e.predicate ELSE p.predicates || CHR(31) || e.predicate END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) predicates, MIN(CASE WHEN p.displays IS NULL THEN e.display_relation ELSE p.displays || CHR(31) || e.display_relation END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) displays
  FROM pk_edges e JOIN cntp0 p ON e.source_node_id = p.node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b8
  GROUP BY e.target_node_id
),
cntp2 AS (
  SELECT e.target_node_id node_id, MIN(p.path_nodes || CHR(31) || e.target_node_id) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) path_nodes, MIN(CASE WHEN p.path_edges IS NULL THEN e.edge_id ELSE p.path_edges || CHR(31) || e.edge_id END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) path_edges, MIN(CASE WHEN p.predicates IS NULL THEN e.predicate ELSE p.predicates || CHR(31) || e.predicate END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) predicates, MIN(CASE WHEN p.displays IS NULL THEN e.display_relation ELSE p.displays || CHR(31) || e.display_relation END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id, p.path_edges) displays
  FROM pk_edges e JOIN cntp1 p ON e.source_node_id = p.node_id
  WHERE e.predicate = :b9 AND e.display_relation IN (:b10)
  GROUP BY e.target_node_id
),
support_rows AS (SELECT a.node_id answer_node_id, p.path_nodes, p.path_edges, p.predicates, p.displays FROM ans a JOIN cntp2 p ON p.node_id=a.node_id)
SELECT 'node' kind, node_id c1, name c2, node_type c3, NULL c4, NULL c5, NULL c6 FROM ans
UNION ALL
SELECT 'support' kind, answer_node_id c1, path_nodes c2, path_edges c3, predicates c4, displays c5, 'count threshold qualified in SQL' c6 FROM support_rows

),
ans AS (

),
ls0 AS (

),
ls1 AS (
  SELECT p.answer_node_id, MIN(e.source_node_id) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) current_node, MIN(e.source_node_id || CHR(31) || p.path_nodes) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_nodes, MIN(e.edge_id || CASE WHEN p.path_edges IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.path_edges END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) path_edges, MIN(e.predicate || CASE WHEN p.predicates IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.predicates END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) predicates, MIN(NVL(e.display_relation, '') || CASE WHEN p.displays IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CHR(31) || p.displays END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY e.edge_id) displays
  FROM ls0 p

br AS (SELECT DISTINCT pa.base_id, pa.pa, e.target_node_id pb, pa.e1, e.edge_id e2, pa.p1, pa.d1, e.predicate p2, e.display_relation d2 FROM pk_edges e JOIN pa ON e.source_node_id=pa.pa WHERE e.predicate=:b6 AND e.display_relation IN (:b7)),
bridges AS (SELECT DISTINCT br.base_id, br.pa, br.pb, e.target_node_id drug, br.e1, br.e2, e.edge_id e3, br.p1, br.p2, e.predicate p3, br.d1, br.d2, e.display_relation d3 FROM pk_edges e JOIN br ON e.source_node_id=br.pb WHERE e.predicate=:b8 AND e.display_relation IN (:b9, :b10, :b11, :b12)),
grp AS (SELECT drug node_id FROM bridges WHERE 1=1 AND drug NOT IN (:b13) GROUP BY drug HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa || '|' || pb) >= :b14),
ans AS (SELECT nd.node_id, nd.name, nd.node_type FROM grp JOIN pk_nodes nd ON nd.node_id=grp.node_id WHERE 1=1 AND nd.node_type IN (:b15)),
